top_themes.label: Other
top_themes.summary: Many users encounter UI issues such as missing cart icons, absent note fields, and app lag, indicating stability and navigation problems in the latest version.

top_themes.label: Trading & orders
top_themes.summary: Users request the option chain to display cost per lot, helping them assess pricing more accurately when trading options.

top_themes.label: Payments & UPI
top_themes.summary: A user complains that the manual SIP payment method was removed, forcing reliance on auto‑payment and reducing control over transaction timing.

quotes.text: i have added a few mf in the cart but I don't see the cart icon anywhere. Now, I don't know how to open cart page and proceed with investment. It seems like major UI glitch in new version if the app.
please add on Cost per Lot in Option Chain.
Removed manual payment option from sip just because they promote auto payment options...

actions.title: Add Cart Icon and Navigation
actions.detail: Introduce a persistent cart icon on the MF screen and a direct link to the cart page for seamless investment flow.

actions.title: Show Cost Per Lot in Option Chain
actions.detail: Add a cost‑per‑lot column to the option chain view, enabling traders to see exact lot pricing at a glance.

actions.title: Restore Manual SIP Payment Option
actions.detail: Re‑enable manual payment selection for SIPs alongside auto, giving users flexibility to schedule payments as preferred.
